typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Class Name} as string,
		Id as string,
		Name as string,
		{Field Name} as string,
		Date as string,
		{User Name} as string,
		{Old Value} as string,
		{New Value} as string,
		Version as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn1
DerivedColumn1 sink(input(
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		UserName as string,
		Version as string,
		OldValue as string,
		ClassName as string,
		NewValue as string,
		Id as string,
		FieldName as string,
		Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate,
		UserName = {User Name},
		Version,
		OldValue = {Old Value},
		ClassName = {Class Name},
		NewValue = {New Value},
		Id,
		FieldName = {Field Name},
		Date,
		Name),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
